Category  → categories
  UNGUARDED (guarded = [])
  relationships: posts (hasMany → Post)

Post  → posts
  FILLABLE (3 field(s))
  relationships: author (belongsTo → User), category (belongsTo → Category), editor (belongsTo → User)

User  → users
  PROTECTED (no fillable/guarded declared)
  casts: email_verified_at:datetime
  relationships: posts (hasMany → Post)
